arguments.old_string: Custom ``key_func`` could be used same way as in :func:`@memoize<memoize>`::
arguments.new_string:
The internal cache dictionary is available as ``api_call.memory``; its values
    are ``(result, timestamp)`` pairs. Raising ``api_call.skip(value)`` from the
    decorated function returns ``value`` without caching it (or ``None`` if no
    value is supplied), just like ``memoize.skip``.

    Custom ``key_func`` could be used same way as in :func:`@memoize<memoize>`::
